relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment efficacy overtime was more pronounced in the group with anti-CGRP treatment with a reduction of migraine frequency overtime, pain intensity, and improved quality of life up to six months post-treatment

key_findings: Anti-CGRP treated CM patients showed less emotion dysregulation, alexithymia and impulsivity and greater, stable efficacy; psychopathology did not influence efficacy.
